seo.title: What is a plugin?
seo.description: A plugin is a package of code that adds a feature to a content management system without changing the system itself.

definition: A plugin is a package of code that adds a feature to a content management system without changing the system itself.
answerBlock: A plugin is a package of code that adds a feature to a content management system without changing the system itself. Plugins are how a WordPress site gains forms, shops, caching or search. Each one is also third-party code running with full access to your site.

body.heading: How many plugins is too many?
paragraphs: There is no magic number, but every plugin adds three liabilities: code you did not write, a maintainer who may stop, and a possible route in for an attacker. Two dozen plugins is two dozen dependencies to keep patched.

The ones that hurt performance are those that load scripts and stylesheets on every page whether or not they are used. A slider plugin used on the homepage should not be adding weight to a service page.

The practical rule is to prefer a small amount of purpose-written code over a large plugin that does ten things you do not need, and to keep a written list of what each plugin is for, so nobody is afraid to remove it.

commercial.heading: Why does it matter commercially?
paragraphs: Unpatched plugins are the most common route to a compromised site, and a compromised site is a data-protection incident as well as an outage.
They are also a recurring cost: annual licences, renewals and the developer time to fix what breaks when one updates.

example.heading: What does it look like in practice?
example.body: A care plan patches plugins on a schedule, tests them against staging first, and reports what changed, which is the only way updates stop being a gamble.

terms.definition: A content management system is the software your team uses to add and edit website content without a developer.
A page builder is a drag-and-drop editor that lets someone assemble a web page from blocks without writing code.
